The Pickpocket is a crew secret identity that wants nothing more than to line their pockets with belongings from their fellow crewmembers.
They may use an action to grab an item out of someone's bag. The target is given no indication of this occuring. However, if they turn to face the Pickpocket, it'll cancel the theft.
The Pickpocket cannot simply loot how they please, however. They cannot steal from someone they've stolen from before, who is unconscious, or is without a bag on their back. The item they steal is also randomly selected, and must be held onto in order to complete the objective.
